A modern take on Vietnamese flavors
Sep 2026 • Solo
I really enjoyed the dining experience at ÚNU Eatery & Bar in Ho Chi Minh City. What stood out to me was the way the restaurant brings Vietnamese ingredients and flavors into a more contemporary setting without making the experience feel overly formal.

The food has a modern presentation, while the drinks add another interesting layer to the experience. I also liked the art-inspired atmosphere, which makes the restaurant feel different from a typical dining spot in the city.

If you're looking for somewhere to experience Vietnamese-inspired flavors in a contemporary setting, ÚNU Eatery & Bar is worth checking out. It is a nice option for a relaxed meal, drinks and a different perspective on Ho Chi Minh City's dining scene.
